tool.description: Compress a file (or any bytes) into the standard LZ4 frame format (.lz4), returned for download. LZ4 is optimised for speed — it compresses and decompresses extremely fast at a modest ratio, ideal for logs, streaming, and real-time pipelines. LZ4 has a single fast mode, so there is no level/quality option. The output is named <input>.lz4. Provide the file as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). Decompress again with any standard lz4 -d / unlz4.

url.description: File URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
